purpose: Give the opening island memorable destinations that support exploration, quest purpose, route memory, mystery, and return-path readability.

points_of_interest.route_role: high-side route destination and long-view island landmark
points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Shows the player the island has authored elevation and a watch point beyond town.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Future signal clue can connect tavern whispers to the island warning line.

points_of_interest.route_role: fork marker between the signal rise, wooded path, and cove route
points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Makes the old road legible without debug signage.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Points toward the first physical trace beyond Newport.

points_of_interest.route_role: shoreline destination on the lower island loop
points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Gives the coast a named-feeling place rather than empty shoreline.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Supports smuggling, missing manifest, and coded-whisper evidence.

points_of_interest.route_role: sheltered path transition between pasture and rise
points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Adds a natural landmark and privacy beat to the route.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Can hide a rumor contact or observation point in later phases.

points_of_interest.route_role: human-scale service edge after leaving Newport
points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Prevents the first island stretch from feeling empty or decorative.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Supports farmhand, courier, or supply clue beats in G-17/G-18.

points_of_interest.route_role: physical evidence node between cove and return lane
points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Gives island exploration a concrete reason before the quest extension lands.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Staged clue site for Whispers Before Dawn.

points_of_interest.route_role: off-route discovery above the signal rise
points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Rewards curiosity with a tucked-away visible cache.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Optional clue can enrich the journal in G-18A.

points_of_interest.exploration_purpose: Keeps the player oriented when looping back from cove or pasture.
points_of_interest.quest_purpose: Supports the return/report beat and next-hook routing.
